the use of the DFC method is the best way to improve the starting performance of an induction motor.
DFC and soft starter are the best methods for starting an induction motor.
the DFC and soft starters are the most suitable for starting the induction machine.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new control strategy for induction machine.
the development of a new control method of induction motor drives, using the field oriented control (FOC), the discrete frequency control and the soft starter.
the comparison of performances during start up of an induction machine with different electronic starters.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the DFC and soft starter are the most effective methods to start up the induction machine with the lowest starting current and highest starting torque.
the 3-phase inverting method is more effective in reducing the starting current and improving the starting torque, while DFC and soft starter are more effective in improving the starting torque.
the 3-phase inverting is the most efficient and the soft starter is the simplest method.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the DFC method is better than the soft starter method and the 3-phase inverter method.
the DFC is the best method to start the induction machine.
the DFC is the best method for the start up of induction motor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the starting period of an induction motor by electronic starters, the torque is increased by 30% and the current is reduced by about 50%.
, in comparison with conventional soft starter, field oriented control (FOC) can be used to improve the performances of the induction motor.
the soft starter method is a simple and efficient solution for induction machine.
